## 中文全文

*“讲给五岁孩子听”系列，第 1 篇*

**开始阅读这篇文章之前，我建议你**[加入这个候补名单](https://ruesandora.com/?bekleme=ac.)**。你会收到一封免费试用邮件。**

问朋友去哪里理发，他们会说出两三家店，而不是两百家。

ChatGPT、Gemini、Claude 和 Perplexity 也是如此。GEO，就是让你进入这份简短推荐名单的方法。

### 朋友测试

你的朋友不会把每家理发店的网站都读一遍。他们会说出那些自己听说过、信得过，而且能用一句话描述的店。“那家便宜，剪得也快。”“那家很擅长打理卷发。”

我是 Rues，一名来自伊斯坦布尔的 SEO、GEO 和 AEO 顾问。人们经常问我：“GEO 是不是只适用于销售型网站？”不是。只要有人可能问 AI 该选谁，GEO 就与你有关。这篇文章就是我的简短回答。

### GEO 是什么

**讲给孩子听的版本。** 一位老师要从大操场上的孩子中挑出三个来搬书。她会选那些自己看得见、了解，而且听别人夸过的孩子。躲在滑梯后面的那个孩子，她就不会选。

**讲给成年人听的版本。** GEO 是 Generative Engine Optimization，也就是生成式引擎优化：让你的品牌更容易被 AI 问答工具找到、理解，并在回答中提及。你还会听到 AEO，即 Answer Engine Optimization，答案引擎优化。在日常工作中，它们重合的部分非常多，所以我把它们当作同一项工作。

### 分别用一句话说明 SEO、GEO 和 AEO

- **SEO**：让你的网页进入链接列表。
- **GEO**：让你的名字出现在答案里。
- **AEO**：让你提供的答案简短、清晰，成为被引用的那个。

GEO 不会取代 SEO，它建立在 SEO 的基础之上。如果机器人读不了你的网站，这三者都发挥不了作用。

### AI 会看什么

四件事。每一件都有一个讲给孩子听的解释。

**1. 它能找到你吗？** 老师没法选中一个她看不见的孩子。机器人必须被允许进入你的网站，而且必须能读到你的文字。爬虫是一种访问并读取网页的程序。一种常见的疏漏是：有人为了拦截垃圾信息，屏蔽了不认识的机器人，后来大家都忘了这件事，结果有用的机器人也被挡在了外面。AI 公司通常还会运行不止一种机器人，所以允许其中一种进入，并不一定意味着其他机器人也能进来。

**2. 你做什么，表达清楚了吗？** 如果有人问“这个孩子是做什么的？”，答案是“她拉小提琴”。用直白的话说清楚你是谁、做什么、在哪里做。聪明的宣传口号对人来说很有趣，但对于试图给你归类的机器人来说，可能毫无用处。

**3. 别人会提到你吗？** 一个只有一位朋友的孩子，很难引起注意；一个被五位同学谈论的孩子，更容易被选中。AI 会从许多地方拼出对你的认识，因此各处的信息应该一致：名称、地址、介绍。

**4. 信息是最新的吗？** 没人会挑一个 2019 年留下来的午餐盒。过时的营业时间、旧价格，以及在 2022 年就停更的博客，都像是在告诉别人：这里已经没人管了。

### 我在于斯屈达尔做的测试

我让 AI 工具推荐于斯屈达尔（Üsküdar）的理发店。每问一次，店名的排列顺序都会变化。离我家最近的那家店一次也没有出现。就这样，一个潜在顾客悄悄流失了，却没有任何人察觉。

这只是一次小测试，不是一项研究。但它说明了为什么单次回答证明不了什么。每次答案都是重新生成的，所以你应该看的是：在多次尝试中，你出现了多少次。用“9 次里有 4 次被提到”来衡量，而不是“我排第一”。

### 操作速查清单（建议保存）

1. 准备 5 个顾客可能会问的问题，在 3 个 AI 工具中分别提问，每个问题在每个工具里问 3 次。记录哪些名字被提到了。
2. 检查你是否不小心屏蔽了机器人。打开 [yourdomain.com/robots.txt](https://yourdomain.com/robots.txt)。
3. 重写网站首页的第一句话，让一个完全不认识你的人在十秒内看懂。
4. 确保网站、地图商家资料和社交账号简介中的名称、营业时间及介绍保持一致。
5. 请一位真实顾客留下诚实的评价。只要真实评价。
6. 两周后再问一遍那 5 个问题，对比结果。

### 常见误区

- **“加上 FAQ 结构化数据就行了。”** Google 已于 2026 年 5 月 7 日停止展示 FAQ 富媒体搜索结果（来源：Google Search Central 更新日志，2026 年 5 月 8 日）。FAQ 常见问题板块仍然可以帮助读者，但它不是让 AI 提到你的捷径。
- **“你可以买到答案里的一个位置。”** 据我所知，没有什么诚实可靠的办法能做到这一点。有人向你出售这种位置时，要小心。
- **“AI 流量太少，没必要管。”** 看看你自己的数据。在 Google Analytics 4 中，默认渠道组里有一个“AI Assistant”（AI 助手）渠道，用于归类 ChatGPT、Gemini 等来源。AI Overviews 和 AI Mode 则被计入 Organic Search（自然搜索）（来源：Google Analytics 帮助）。

### 我正在做什么

我在运营 Ruesandora，并开发 Ruescan。这是一个扫描工具，会像机器人一样，从外部读取网站。Rue 是它的助手。Ruescan 目前还未开放，可以加入候补名单。

### 轮到你了

没人能保证你一定会出现在 AI 的回答里。但你可以不再做那个躲在滑梯后面的孩子，而且其中大部分工作都不花钱。

在回复里告诉我你所在的细分行业和城市。我会检查 AI 对这个领域是怎么回答的，然后告诉你我看到了什么。

英文指南、笔记和 Ruescan 候补名单：[https://ruesandora.com/?bekleme=ac](https://ruesandora.com/?bekleme=ac)

**本系列下一篇，第 2 篇：** robots.txt 和 AI 机器人。那张贴在你门口的小纸条，决定了哪些机器人可以进来；我会教你如何在两分钟内看懂自己网站的这张“纸条”。关注我，别错过。

## 英文原文

### GEO, explained like you're 5

*Part 1 of the "Explained like you're 5" series*

**Before you start reading the article, I recommend** [joining this waitlist](https://ruesandora.com/?bekleme=ac.)**. You'll receive a free trial email.**

Ask a friend where to get a haircut and they name two or three places. Not two hundred.

ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity do the same. GEO is how you get on that short list.

### The friend test

Your friend does not read every barber's website. They name places they have heard of, trust, and can describe in one sentence. "That one is cheap and quick." "That one is great with curly hair."

I am Rues, an SEO, GEO and AEO consultant from Istanbul. People keep asking me things like "Is GEO only for sales sites?" No. If someone can ask an AI who to pick, GEO touches you. This is my short answer.

### What GEO is

**Kid version.** A teacher picks three kids from a huge school yard to carry books. She picks the ones she can see, understand, and has heard good things about. She skips the kid hiding behind the slide.

**Grown-up version.** GEO is Generative Engine Optimization: making your brand easy for AI answer tools to find, understand and name. You will also hear AEO, Answer Engine Optimization. In daily work they overlap so much that I treat them as one job.

### SEO, GEO, AEO in one line each

- **SEO** gets your page into a list of links.
- **GEO** gets your name inside the answer.
- **AEO** makes your answer the short, clear one that gets quoted.

GEO does not replace SEO. It sits on top of it. If a bot cannot read your site, none of the three works.

### What AI looks at

Four things. Each has a kid version.

**1. Can it find you?** The teacher cannot pick a kid she cannot see. Bots must be allowed in and must be able to read your text. A crawler is a program that visits pages and reads them. A common slip: someone blocks unknown bots to stop spam, nobody remembers, and the useful bots get blocked too. AI companies also tend to run more than one bot, so letting one in does not always let the others in.

**2. Is it clear what you do?** If someone asks "what does this kid do?", the answer is "she plays violin". Say who you are, what you do and where, in plain words. A clever slogan is fun for people and useless for a bot trying to label you.

**3. Do others mention you?** A kid with one friend is hard to notice. A kid five classmates talk about gets picked. AI builds its picture of you from many places, and the details should match everywhere: name, address, description.

**4. Is it up to date?** Nobody picks a lunchbox from 2019. Old hours, old prices and a blog that stopped in 2022 say nobody is home.

### My Üsküdar test

I asked AI tools for a hairdresser in Üsküdar. The order of names changed on every try. The salon closest to my home never appeared. That is a customer lost without anyone knowing.

It was one small test, not a study. But it shows why one answer proves nothing. The answer is written fresh each time, so look at how often you appear across many tries. Think "named in 4 of 9", not "I am number one".

### Cheat sheet (save this)

1. Ask 5 questions your customer would ask, on 3 AI tools, 3 times each. Write down who gets named.
2. Check that you are not blocking bots by accident. Open [yourdomain.com/robots.txt](https://yourdomain.com/robots.txt).
3. Rewrite your homepage's first sentence so a stranger gets it in ten seconds.
4. Make your name, hours and description match across your site, map listing and social bios.
5. Ask one real customer for an honest review. Only real ones.
6. Repeat the 5 questions in two weeks and compare.

### Myths

- **"Just add FAQ schema."** Google stopped showing FAQ rich results on May 7, 2026 (Google Search Central changelog, May 8, 2026). An FAQ section can still help readers. It is no shortcut to being named by AI.
- **"You can buy a spot in the answer."** I know of no honest way. Be careful with anyone who sells one.
- **"AI traffic is small, so skip it."** Check your own numbers. In Google Analytics 4, the default channel group has an "AI Assistant" channel for sources like ChatGPT and Gemini. AI Overviews and AI Mode are counted as Organic Search instead (Google Analytics Help).

### What I am building

I run Ruesandora and build Ruescan, a scanner that reads a website from the outside, the way bots do. Rue is its assistant. Ruescan is closed for now, and there is a waitlist.

### Your turn

Nobody can promise you a place in an AI answer. But you can stop being the kid behind the slide, and most of that work is free.

Reply with your niche and your city. I will check how AI answers for it and tell you what I see.

English guides, notes and the Ruescan waitlist: [https://ruesandora.com/?bekleme=ac](https://ruesandora.com/?bekleme=ac)
